name: What is a garage conversion ADU?

mainEntity.name: What is a garage conversion ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit) transforms an existing garage into a separate, independent living space. This can include a kitchen, bathroom, and sleeping area. It's an efficient way to add housing to your property without building a new structure from the ground up. Common uses include rental income, housing for family members, or a dedicated home office. We handle all aspects of design and construction to ensure your new ADU meets local regulations and your personal needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion ADU transforms an existing garage into a separate living space, complete with a kitchen and bathroom.
